info.title: PM360 API
info.description:
Contract for PM360 — Enterprise Project Portfolio, Resource, Delivery and Financial Management platform.

**This is the shared contract between frontend and backend.** The frontend builds against the mock server; the backend implements these exact shapes.

Conventions:
- All ids are UUID v4.
- All money fields are decimal numbers; format at presentation only.
- All list endpoints return `{items, total, page, page_size}`.
- Every operation carries `x-permission` naming the RBAC permission it requires.
- Errors return `{detail, code?, field_errors?}`.
- Timestamps are RFC3339 UTC; dates are ISO-8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`.
